purpose:
Bounded native Marionette actual-parent integration control; disposable owned profile only.

Protocol and command shapes are from Mozilla's reference client, not Juggler.
No packages, drivers, personal profiles, desktop capture or browser preferences
outside this profile are installed or changed. This tests actual-parent attachment and geometry; it does not certify cold S1 timing or continuous pixels.

runtime.algorithm: SHA256 of sorted <sha256><two spaces><relative POSIX path><LF> records

fixtureNotice: Accepted fixed civil calendar, provider transport and real1x clock fixture; actual installed parent and native settings. Not live weather or owner location.

capabilities.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64; rv:150.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/150.0

parentImport.changedField: Widget URL only; exact parent wrapper preserved. Actual local-mode resolver consumes disclosed Orlando provider fixture; no direct target assignment. Warm parent integration, no S1 claim.

fixtureInsertion.scope: Clock/provider transport only; original application bytes unchanged

native.elevationSource: native response elevation bound to this target generation

last.model: V5 nominal lunar-Lambert / grey finite Earth; not calibrated spectroscopy

quality.method: 64/256 full + ambiguous-source minimum1024 + selected4096/8192; local display-change criterion
quality.scope: angular-rule discriminator; independent dense-reference, spatial, terrain and photometry errors are separate

scene.geometryConvention: native accepted phase; leading-edge bounded display approximation while advancing, nearest while fixed; .0416 device px maximum; no future UTC

moon.calendarProxy: refined phase/relief scaled to at most the former .020×material mean luminance; zero physical moonlight

sky.workerFailurePolicy: retain only a current displayed sky; never synchronous physical rendering on the prayer UI thread
sky.dprPolicy: 325×530 physics raster at DPR 1; browser scales canvas; no high-DPR certification
